description: This file defines a Java interface for a mutable builder pattern used to construct JsonException instances, including methods for setting message, description, cause, and href, and a build method.

classes.name: JsonExceptionBuilder
classes.description: A Java interface for building JsonException objects with methods to set message, description, cause, href, and to build the exception.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Sets the detail message of the exception to be built, either directly or via a supplier.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Sets a description with further information about the exception, either directly or via a supplier.

methods.name: cause
methods.description: Sets the cause of the exception, either directly or via a supplier.

methods.name: href
methods.description: Sets a URI link to further information about the exception, either directly or via a supplier.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an instance of the specified JsonException type using the set data.
